log.notes_to_self: Day1 plan: test which place kinds L can trace. Killed d1-10 (national, quick, afternoon), d1-6 (wire = sector, timed, evening), d1-3 (cable = age, timed, evening). All deaths were traced (only 3 deaths, fewer than 5). Watch the traced count: +0 means sector and age are both unreachable, so regional, forum and foreign are reachable. +2 means both are reachable. +1 is ambiguous. Hidden extra reports can also make a trace fail. Routine safety: the deaths in any routine's busy blocks must stay at 2 or fewer. Night worker busy blocks: evening and night. Day workers busy: morning and afternoon. Students busy: morning and night. Home: never busy. Keeping quick kills at 2 or fewer and timed kills at 2 or fewer per day reveals no routine. Putting all quick kills in the afternoon only rules out day workers (pool falls to 55%). Never let 3 successful traces build up from one place I follow. Tally of successful traces by place so far: unknown (d1 wire 1?, cable 1?).

Day 1 result: the traced count went up by 2, so wire (sector) and cable (age) are both reachable. The two unreachable kinds are therefore two of: regional, forum, foreign. Successful traces so far: wire 1, cable 1. NEVER let any place reach 3 successful traces. Kill at most 1 more from wire and 1 more from cable, and only if needed. Day 2 kills: d2-7 (national, quick, afternoon), d2-1 (regional North, quick, afternoon), d2-3 (forum, timed, evening), d2-2 (foreign, timed, evening). All 4 will be traced. Expected traced count after day 2: 3 (2 + 1 from whichever of regional, forum, foreign is reachable). If it is 2, a hidden extra report blocked the reachable one. To work out which kind is reachable, test one place alone on a later day. Then kill freely from the 2 unreachable kinds and keep the reachable one under 3 traces. Routine safety: quick kills at 2 or fewer per day (morning and afternoon are busy for day workers), timed kills in the evening (counts against night workers only, max 2). More than 2 quick kills in a day rules out day workers (pool drops to 55%). Consider accepting that later to raise points.

Day 3 plan: test whether regional is the reachable kind. Before day 3 the traced count was 3, with wire 1, cable 1 and one of North/forum/foreign at 1. Day 3 kills: d3-1 (national, quick, afternoon), d3-2 (regional North, quick, morning), d3-5 (wire, timed, evening), d3-8 (cable, timed, evening). That is 4 kills and all 4 get traced. Read the day 3 traced count: 6 means regional is reachable (North now at 2; STOP North kills forever; forum and foreign are free). 5 means regional is unreachable, so forum or foreign is reachable with 1 trace. Next, test forum alone; a small chance a hidden report blocked one trace adds ambiguity. 4 or less means hidden reports blocked traces, so re-test. Wire and cable are now at 2 traces each: NEVER kill from wire or cable again. Kill freely only from confirmed-unreachable kinds. Keep the reachable kind at 2 or fewer traces. Routine safety: at most 2 quick kills a day (morning/afternoon), timed kills in the evening, at most 2. Later, consider more than 2 quick kills, since that only cuts the pool to 55%. Also, if a day has more than 5 kills, only 5 get traced, chosen at random.

Day 4 notes. History: day 1 wire and cable were both traced, so sector and age are REACHABLE. Day 2 the count rose by 1 from one of North/forum/foreign. Day 3 the count rose 3 to 5, which is only +2 from North, wire and cable. So North most likely failed, meaning REGIONAL is UNREACHABLE. The small alternative is that a hidden report blocked wire or cable. If regional is unreachable, the day-2 trace came from forum or foreign, and the reachable kinds are sector, age and one of forum/foreign. Estimated traced counts: wire 2, cable 2, North 0 (maybe 1), forum or foreign 1. NEVER kill from wire or cable again. Day 4 kills: d4-8 national (quick, morning), d4-1 North (quick, afternoon), d4-3 forum (timed, evening). Read the day 4 count, starting from 5: +1 means forum is reachable (forum now at 2, STOP forum; foreign is unreachable and free). +0 means forum is unreachable, so foreign is reachable with 1 (or a hidden block occurred). +2 would mean North is also reachable; then STOP North. If regional looks unreachable after day 4, kill 2 North a day plus the free kind. Routine: at most 2 quick kills a day (morning/afternoon), up to 2 timed in the evening. Later, plan to ramp up kills for the multiplier (30 deaths in 5 days) using unreachable kinds. Note that hidden reports in places I don't follow can also get counted, but those only constrain me to 'follows at least one'.

Day 5 notes. Reachability deduction: day 1 traced wire and cable, so sector and age are REACHABLE. Day 3 gave only +2, so REGIONAL is likely UNREACHABLE. Day 4 gave +1 (pool count 5 to 6) from the North quick kill plus the forum timed kill, so forum is likely REACHABLE (forum traces = 2) and FOREIGN is UNREACHABLE. Traced counts so far: wire 2, cable 2, forum 2, North 0, foreign 0. NEVER kill wire, cable or forum again: a 3rd trace in any of them triggers narrowing (sector 20% x age 25% x forum 25% means capture). SAFE sources are national, regional North and foreign. Day 5 kills: d5-11 national quick morning, d5-1 North quick afternoon, d5-3 and d5-6 foreign timed evening. Read the day 5 count: if it rises by 2 or more, my deduction is wrong, so reassess (a single +1 could be a hidden report). Routine: keep daytime deaths at 2 or fewer so day workers are not ruled out; 2 timed kills in the evening. That gives 4 kills a day. For the multiplier (30 deaths in 5 days) I would need about 6 a day plus, using up to 10 quick daytime kills, which rules out day workers and maybe students. Pool 100k x 0.35 is still huge if the trace kinds stay clean, so consider ramping up later using North + foreign + national (about 5 a day max), which is not enough for 30 anyway. So the multiplier is likely unreachable; just keep the safe steady score.

Day 6 notes. Reachability: day 1 traced wire and cable, so SECTOR and AGE are REACHABLE. Day 3 gave only +2, so REGIONAL is likely UNREACHABLE. Day 4 gave +1, so FORUM is likely REACHABLE and FOREIGN is UNREACHABLE. Day 5 count stayed at 6 after North and foreign kills, which confirms North and foreign are untraceable. Traced counts so far: wire 2, cable 2, forum 2. NEVER kill wire, cable or forum: a 3rd trace in any of them triggers narrowing. SAFE sources are national, regional North and foreign. Routine: keep daytime (morning and afternoon) deaths at 2 or fewer so day workers stay in the pool, and morning deaths at 2 or fewer so students stay too. Standard plan is 4 kills a day: national quick morning, 1 North or foreign quick afternoon, 2 North or foreign timed evening. Day 6 kills: d6-8 national quick morning, d6-4 North quick afternoon, d6-2 and d6-5 foreign timed evening. Check the day 6 count: if it rises, reassess (a hidden report in wire, cable or forum could cause it). The multiplier is unreachable, so keep the steady safe score.

NEVER kill wire, cable or forum, because a 3rd trace in any of them triggers narrowing. SAFE sources are national, regional North and foreign. Any victim reported in North or foreign cannot be traced, since a trace needs every place to be reachable. From day 7 I kill ALL safe criminals, usually 5 (national, 2 North, 2 foreign). Layout: national quick morning, 2 quick afternoon, 2 timed evening. Keep morning deaths at 1 or fewer so students stay in the pool. Day workers are now ruled out (3 daytime deaths), and that is accepted: the pool should settle at about 55k (night workers, students, at-home), far above 1,000. Source narrowing is impossible while I avoid wire, cable and forum. Day 7 kills: d7-5 national quick morning, d7-2 and d7-10 North quick afternoon, d7-4 and d7-9 foreign timed evening. Check: the traced count should stay at 6 and the pool should be about 50k or 60k. If the count rises, reassess. The multiplier is unreachable.
